summary: Nuran Wireless filed a 6-K with exhibits covering a Series A convertible preferred share private placement increased to C$7.6 million (from C$6.5 million) at C$4.25 per preferred share, convertible at C$5.00 per common share (0.85 common per preferred). An institutional investor subscribed via an amending agreement; ~C$3.85 million of the subscription was satisfied by settling a convertible debenture, with additional debt and salary settlements. Proceeds support Nasdaq Capital Market listing expected to commence August 17, 2026. Board increased authorized preferred shares to 2,000,000. What to watch: conversion overhang and Nasdaq listing execution.
